hub_url.description: Plain HTTP VirtualHub/YoctoHub origin, e.g. http://virtualhub.local:4444. No credentials or path are accepted; the provider polls /bySerial/{endpoint}/api.json and verifies the hardware serial/product identity.

YoctoWattConfiguration.description: ESP measurement provider via HTTP VirtualHub/YoctoHub, bound by hardware serial YWATMK2C-... in endpoint. DC voltage/current/power and optional AC/power-factor channels use common readings. Native PC USB is instead available through the host endpoint yocto+usb://SERIAL and official SDK. Native Yocto USB on ESP is not implemented; physical commissioning remains open.
